feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of all frontend components and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based style definitions configuring color variables and theming for light/dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/ch: Defines the Chocolate interface and exports a list containing one favorite chocolate entry.
frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/Ch: Main multi-step flow page controlling navigation, progress indication, and rendering each step including gallery and virtual gift.
Displays favorite chocolate card with reveal button and visual effects.
Dialog showing chocolate image and romantic message with animations and close controls.
frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/Fl: Back/Next step navigation component with button state handling.
Visual step indicator with current step text and progress dots.
frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/He: Generates animated floating heart particles unless reduced motion is preferred.
frontend/src/components/chocolate-day/st: Renders the first sweet message step with decorative hearts, sparkles, and romantic text.
Displays the second message step with animated hearts and multiple uplifting paragraphs.
Shows a revealable virtual chocolate gift box with images, animations, and heartfelt messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s Internet Identity, refreshing queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, including login, identity loading, and state management.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles, custom romantic color variables, and animations for the UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, Internet Identity provider, and React Query client.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling dark mode, custom OKLCH color tokens, extended theming, animations, and typography/container/animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a multi‑page romantic Chocolate Day experience, required images, feature list, and architectural notes.
